title: Hovering the Billing Efficiency chart shows each advisor's percent and ELR
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  1. You are signed in as an Admin (the Admin role has every permission, including Reports).
  2. You are in one location (workplace) with the data below.
  3. You use a desktop browser at 100% zoom on a screen at least 1024 pixels wide (any ordinary laptop or desktop monitor).
  4. At least two service advisors have invoiced work with clocked time over the last twelve months in this location.

Setup

  • For 1: on the QA site's sign-in page, in the DEV MODE — QUICK LOGIN panel, click Admin (this signs you in as Admin ShopView). To use another role, check it has Reports: profile icon > Settings > Roles & Permissions > edit icon on the role > Reports is switched on.
  • For 2: to change location, click your profile icon (your initials, top right, beside the current location name) > under Change Location: click the orange button showing the current location > pick the location from the list. On the QA site use Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 unless a later line says otherwise.
  • For 4: check: Billing Efficiency set to Last 12 Months > View details > Advisor filter lists at least two names; then set the pill back to This Month (the dashboard remembers your choices). If not, create an invoice with clocked time for each advisor: Customers > New Customer > Name > Save (for example ZZAUTOTEST Dash Customer); Work Orders > Create Work Order > in the New Work Order window pick the Customer and an Asset (Add beside either if needed) > Save (if a Confirmation says the customer is over their credit limit, click Create); the New Line window opens: What Are You Doing? (any text), Add Technician = Tech ShopView, Labor Rate = EVR Travel to EVO ($100 an hour), Estimated Time 1 and Tech Time 1, tick Line Approved > Save & Close; then the Service Advisor is filled in with your name (Admin ShopView); to use another advisor change Service Advisor in the work order's left panel; clock time as the technician: in a second browser or a private window, on the QA site's sign-in page, in the DEV MODE — QUICK LOGIN panel, click Tech (this signs you in as Tech ShopView, a technician at Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 with Time Clock on); open the work order > on the line's Labor row click Start; when done click Stop > Clock Out; to make the time exact, as Admin: the three dots at the top right of the Lines tab > Timesheets (n) > edit the record's start and end (if it cannot be edited there or in Reports > Timesheet Activities, keep the real time and use the hours Timesheet Activities shows); on the line click Story (Add tech story for this line) > type a short story > Update; click Complete (if a Missing Details window asks for Mileage, enter one > Complete All Lines); click Mark Reviewed; Finance tab > Create Invoice; close the New Customer Payment window without paying (do not send or pay the invoice). Then repeat with a second customer and, in the work order's left panel, a different Service Advisor.
custom_steps:
1. Click Dashboard in the top bar.
  2. Set the Billing Efficiency pill to Last 12 Months.
  3. Click View details on the Billing Efficiency tile.
  4. Hover a month where several advisors have points (e.g. Jul 2026).
  5. Read the box (tooltip) that appears beside the hovered month on the chart.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The tooltip names the month at the top (e.g. Jul 2026).
  • For each advisor it shows the billing efficiency percent (e.g. the advisor's name: 117%) and, on the line below, that advisor's ELR as a dollar amount (e.g. ELR: $172.25).

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9581 (Story 9, Chart Behavior); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850 v42, read 7 Oct 2026, Story 9. Split out of C88622. Design canvas (claude.ai/artifact/Wae9DFQ8PJQBy8mbLsL5ge, screenshots of the SV-8311 build captured 2026-09-28) board 05_Billing_Hover (tooltip layout: month, then each advisor's percent with ELR on a second line), used for on-screen labels only.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S9-R5: “When the user hovers a point on the Billing Efficiency chart, the tooltip shows that advisor's billing efficiency percent and that advisor's ELR dollar amount.”
